mainEntity.name: How can I exchange my product?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Currently, we do not offer pickup services for exchanges. The exchange process is as follows:

  1. Email us at queries@triprindia.com
    with your Order ID and reason for exchange
  2. Exchange requests must be raised within 7 days of receiving the product
  3. Our team will review your request within 24–48 hours and share the return address
  4. Send the product via a manual courier
  5. Share a copy of the courier receipt via email for tracking
  6. Products must be returned in original packaging with all tags intact
  7. Ship the parcel via manual courier to:

Chakra Production
S.F. No. 396,
Pudupalayam, Tirupur South,
Mudalipalayam,
Tirupur – 641606,
Tamil Nadu

*Product Opening Video is Mandatory for all Claims

Note: Offers, exchanges, and returns are not applicable for innerwear products, including vests and trunks.

acceptedAnswer.text:

  • Email: queries@triprindia.com
    with your Order ID and details
  • Return requests must be raised within 7 days of receiving the product
  • Once approved, you’ll receive confirmation via email
  • Pack the product securely in original packaging with tags
  • Ship the parcel via manual courier to:

    Chakra Production

    Mudalipalayam,
